issues.detail: The Greek 'και ου κρατων' (and not holding/grasping) is part of a participial construction. The Vietnamese 'và không nắm giữ đầu, từ đó...' suggests a causal sequence ('from that') that is not present in the Greek text. The Greek structure implies that because the head is not being grasped/held [by something else], the body is supplied and joined.
